item.title: This Day In Dodgers History: Jackie Robinson Featured On Wheaties Cereal Boxes
item.description: On February 11, 1997, General Mills, the makers of Wheaties, unveiled three new Jackie Robinson cereal boxes to be sold in stores nationwide. It was to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the Brooklyn Dodgers Hall of Famer breaking MLB’s color barrier. Robinson became the first athlete to simultaneously be featured on all three varieties of […]
